
orion-node  monitor this host and report to Orion Core

USAGE   orion-node <command> [flags]

 START HERE
   setup     connect this host and choose what to monitor
   doctor    check everything and fix what is wrong
   status    see what the node is doing right now

 DAY TO DAY
   logs      read node and shipped logs
   config    show, diff, validate and edit settings
   update    upgrade safely, with rollback
   service   start, stop, restart, install

 EXAMPLES
   $ orion-node setup
   $ orion-node logs --follow --level warn
   $ orion-node status --short

 More: enroll · discover · usage · maintenance · token · version · run · start
       · stop · restart · reconfigure · state · emit · run-job
